subject: CS360
filterSummary: Successfully selected 10 videos (5 English, 5 Arabic) covering all specified topics. Selections prioritize direct relevance, educational quality, and high viewership to ensure student engagement. For topics with overlapping candidates, unique videos were chosen for each slot to maximize learning breadth. In one case, the best Arabic video for a topic was already used, so the next-best alternative was selected.
